judgment: Human review of symptom, expected behavior and actual source support, without correcting model outputs; match each gold claim at most once.
issue_only_control: Report semantic content separately; absent video timestamps cannot establish temporal grounding.
code_checkpoint: Use the existing harness against a Docker-only buggy checkout with history removed. Record inspected supporting source locations and distinguish hypotheses. No fixes before frozen reproduction failure.
privacy: Only problem_statement plus registered media may reach extraction. No gold claims, supplied tests, gold source/test patches, grader scripts or gold-derived notes.
